standard_prerequisites.name: Invertible pushforward detection
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the kernel as a pushforward from a section.

core_obligations: Lower bound: pairing with E boxtimes G and pushing forward computes Hom-type cohomology of the image; a surjection onto H^i(K) from E^vee boxtimes G^vee makes it nonzero, killing degrees i < 0.
Upper bound via dimension-zero supports gives i <= 0; so K is a single sheaf in degree 0.
Pushforwards of point sheaves detect the support of K as finite over pr_2; the invertible-pushforward lemma writes K = s_* O_X; functoriality forces s to be the diagonal.
proof_roadmap: Bound both ends, reduce to a sheaf, then detect the section and conclude.
difficulty_reason: Degree-bounding via box-tensor surjections plus a section-detection argument; fully displayed.
